title: Single-Cell GEX and VDJ (TCR) Sequencing Protocol
author: Hyojin Song

steps.title: Prepare PBMC Samples
steps.instruction: Thaw PBMC samples and wash with warm DMEM + 10% FBS.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 1× PBS + 1% BSA to a final concentration of 100–2,000 cells/µL.

steps.title: Prepare GEX and TCR Libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare Gene Expression (GEX) and T-cell receptor (TCR) libraries following the manufacturer’s protocols for the 10x Genomics Chromium GEM-X Single Cell V(D)J + 5’ Gene Expression (v3) kit.

steps.title: Generate Customized Reference Genome
steps.instruction: Use cellranger mkref (v7.0.1) to generate a customized reference genome by aggregating the human reference (GRCh38/hg38) with GCAR1 construct sequences.

steps.title: Align Sequencing Data
steps.instruction: Align sequencing data to the customized reference using cellranger multi (v7.0.1).

steps.title: Perform Initial Data Subset and QC
steps.instruction: Identify VDJ+ cells from the GEX dataset and subset them for downstream analyses using Seurat (v5).

substeps.instruction: Identify GCAR1-expressing cells using subset (SeuratObject, subset = GCAR > 0).
Apply QC filters: Raw nCount_RNA > 5,000 and Mitochondrial RNA percentage (percent.mt) < 20%.

steps.title: Normalize and Integrate Data
steps.instruction: Normalize data using SCTransform, regressing out mitochondrial content, and integrate samples across timepoints.

substeps.instruction: Generate integrated expression values with IntegrateData().

steps.title: Perform Cell Clustering
steps.instruction: Perform cell clustering at resolution 0.8 to generate 30 clusters.

substeps.instruction: Assign each cell a TCR clonotype based on paired TRA and TRB chains.
Uniquely identify each TCR clonotype using a combination of V, D, J, C gene segments and CDR nucleotide sequences.
Retain only cells with a single productive TRB chain for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Predict Cell Types
steps.instruction: Perform unsupervised cell-type labelling using SCimilarity (v0.2.0; “unconstrained” model).

substeps.instruction: Re-run the model in “constrained” mode to obtain a min_dist value for each cell’s label prediction (where 0 indicates an identical match to the reference).
Calculate a cluster label score using the formula: cluster label score_x = (threshold(min_dist) – median(min_dist))_k × proportion(x_c).

steps.title: Validate Annotations
steps.instruction: Perform pathway enrichment analysis to extract cluster-specific marker genes.

substeps.instruction: Use FindAllMarkers() (with performNormalization()) to find markers with avg_log2FC > 1.0.
Query markers with the g:Profiler2 R package focusing on GO:BP terms.

steps.title: Annotate GCAR1 Status
steps.instruction: Annotate clusters as GCAR1+ if they contain >250 cells or >15% GCAR1+ cells.

substeps.instruction: Calculate p-values for the proportion of GCAR1-positive cells in each cluster using a two-proportion z-test.

steps.title: Classify Cell Types
steps.instruction: Refine SCimilarity cell-level labels into broad cell types using semi-manual curation and tumour marker gene expression levels.

substeps.instruction: Retain cells only if cell-level and cluster-level annotations agree on T-cell status.

steps.title: Profile Marker Gene Expression
steps.instruction: Profile CAR T-cell immunophenotyping genes using established published marker lists.
